purpose: Prospective coverage and admission contract for the second NN arithmetic campaign; not a record that every listed operation has been executed
target: SM80 NVIDIA A100; record actual returned model, memory size, clocks, driver and toolkit per run
execution_record_note: The prospective families and missing-native-implementation entries below are preserved. Actual tested, shared-runtime and uncovered coverage is recorded separately with immutable experiment references.

measurement_scopes.native_kernel: OpenAssembler-generated SASS versus ptxas on the identical generated PTX and launch contract
measurement_scopes.vendor_operator: Matched PyTorch/ATen/cuBLAS CUDA operation; count all required launches, conversions, allocation and saved outputs
measurement_scopes.hybrid_workload: Native OpenAssembler or same-PTX ptxas replaces explicitly enumerated operations; remaining CUDA operations are shared and attributed
measurement_scopes.compiled_application: Existing OpenAssembler application capture uses AOTAutograd/Inductor/Triton; compare against both eager CUDA and direct stock compiled PyTorch, never attribute this route to native OA SASS

categories.native_status: Native FP16/BF16 contiguous-K full-tile C=A@B.T with FP32 accumulation/output; alpha/beta generally unsupported
categories.candidate: Per-shape choice of existing pointer homes, CTA traversal and legal fused epilogue
categories.gate: Complete finite outputs versus independent FP64 reference on rounded operands; exact same-PTX check separately; output guards

categories.native_status: No native batched/fused attention integration; explicit per-head GEMM composition requires padded full tiles and conversion
categories.candidate: Batch independent heads without silently dropping packing and host launch overhead
categories.gate: Complete attention outputs and all Q/K/V gradients; compare identical masks, scale and saved tensors

categories.native_status: Expressible scalar PTX; selected GEMM fused FP32 bias/residual epilogues exist
categories.candidate: Fuse identical elementary arithmetic or use two/four elements per thread with complete tails
categories.gate: Elementwise expected expression with declared contraction policy and all outputs poisoned before replay

categories.native_status: Forward scalar example validated; backward requires explicit experimental source
categories.candidate: Multiple contiguous elements per thread or bias/residual fusion
categories.gate: Elementwise exact check including zero, sign boundaries and tails

categories.native_status: Tanh-approximate scalar forward example validated; no native backward API
categories.candidate: Instruction-level parallelism and bounded fusion under an unchanged tanh-approximate mathematical contract
categories.gate: Independent high-precision tanh formula and analytic derivative; exact same-PTX check reported separately

categories.native_status: No production fused SwiGLU operator; elementary expressions may compile in supported PTX subset
categories.candidate: Fuse sigmoid/gate multiplication and matched backward pointwise expressions
categories.gate: Independent FP64 formula over bounded inputs including saturation and zero

categories.native_status: Production cooperative forward FP32 y-only widths 1..1024; backward not implemented
categories.candidate: Warps per CTA, elements per lane, safe shuffle synchronization and fused scale/mask
categories.gate: Full rows versus FP64 reference, row sums, tails and bounded finite patterns; backward zero-sum and analytic reference

categories.native_status: Production y-only non-affine FP32 forward width <=1024; no saved statistics/affine/backward
categories.candidate: Joint row mapping and live ranges; distinguish shifted two-pass variance from unstable sum-of-squares shortcuts
categories.gate: Full output and saved statistics versus stable FP64 population normalization; all gradients if implemented

categories.native_status: Existing transformer uses shared PyTorch/Inductor expressions; no native operator API
categories.candidate: Remove unnecessary mean subtraction and fuse row scaling with matched saved inverse RMS
categories.gate: FP64 formula, width tails and all gradients under fixed epsilon

categories.native_status: Shared CUDA runtime in existing MLP; no tuned native reduction API
categories.candidate: Cooperative two-stage reduction with explicit workspace and no omitted second stage
categories.gate: All columns against FP64 sum with declared FP32 accumulation tolerance

categories.native_status: Shared CUDA in existing hybrid MLP
categories.candidate: Fuse pointwise derivative with fixed upstream scalar and reduction policy
categories.gate: Full derivative and scalar loss against FP64; reduction denominator unchanged

categories.native_status: Old scalar forward example failed byte-exact ptxas gate; no admitted production training loss
categories.candidate: Cooperative fused loss/gradient under declared new accuracy contract, retaining historical failure
categories.gate: Full per-row losses and all gradient entries with valid labels, extreme finite logits and denominator policy

categories.native_status: Shared PyTorch in transformer workflow; not native OA integrated
categories.candidate: Multi-tensor norm and scale with same overflow and epsilon semantics
categories.gate: All raw and clipped gradients plus global norm; policy never adjusted to admit faster results

categories.native_status: Example fused Adam-like kernel is not AdamW: lacks bias correction and decoupled decay; whole workloads use shared Torch AdamW
categories.candidate: Fused exact policy update on independent tensors; immutable input buffers for isolated graph timing
categories.gate: All parameters, first/second moments, step counters and gradients for multiple updates with unchanged epsilon/decay/bias correction

categories.native_status: Scalar expressions can compile; no native multi-tensor optimizer integration
categories.candidate: Fuse momentum and parameter update with explicit policy and full state
categories.gate: All parameter/momentum tensors across several steps; not compared to AdamW as equivalent training

categories.native_status: Recorded SM80 instruction sequences and approximate math exist; precise exceptional-value contracts differ by form
categories.candidate: Latency hiding across independent elements and equivalent address/instruction sequence selection
categories.gate: Domain declared per instruction, full FP64/bit-level checks, accuracy and throughput reported independently

categories.native_status: Native constant division/rem and pointer address generation implemented
categories.candidate: Compile-time divisor/index decomposition, fewer live address registers and legal strength reduction
categories.gate: Exact integer results including boundaries, signedness and overflow semantics; no guessed truncation

categories.native_status: GEMM requires contiguous K and full tiles; surrounding conversions/packing are shared CUDA operations
categories.candidate: Reuse exact packed immutable weights in inference; fuse packing only if full lifetime/invalidation correct
categories.gate: All logical and padded elements, exact casts, guards and invalidation after parameter updates

categories.native_status: Original model uses shared SDPA causal mask and learned position embeddings; no native RoPE API
categories.candidate: Fuse scale/mask into score staging or pointwise rotary operations without changing position convention
categories.gate: Full outputs/gradients, causal zeros and position offsets; fully masked-row policy fixed

categories.native_status: Shared library path; no validated native embedding/scatter atomic implementation
categories.candidate: Coalesced gather or deterministic grouped gradient reduction needs separate future implementation
categories.gate: Full outputs and repeated-token gradients; duplicate-index accumulation and determinism contract

categories.native_status: No native RNG/dropout integration; older transformer uses no dropout
categories.candidate: Counter-based RNG/fusion requires matching declared RNG semantics and should not be claimed from dropout-disabled tests
categories.gate: Saved mask/gradient consistency, seed/counter reproducibility and fixed dropout probability

categories.native_status: Outside current native transformer/MLP contract; no tuned convolution frontend/runtime
categories.candidate: Separate future implicit-GEMM or direct-convolution work, not inferred from dense GEMM timings
categories.gate: Padding/stride/dilation/group semantics, all outputs and gradients if expanded to CNNs

categories.native_status: Single-GPU study only; no NCCL/native distributed stack claim
categories.candidate: Compute/communication overlap requires real multi-GPU measurements, not virtual A100 cluster assumptions
categories.gate: Global tensor correctness and synchronization across actual participating ranks

workload_designs.description: Small, medium and compute-heavy residual MLP; all forward/dX/dW GEMMs replaceable, all activation/loss/optimizer state checked
Explicit scaled attention forward/backward plus MLP, rather than calling a score matrix complete attention; shared unsupported operators labelled
Tiny, long-context and wide/deep full forward/backward/optimizer cases using current application workflow; stock compiled PyTorch baseline needed for attribution

kernel_checks: output poisoned after CUDA graph capture
workload_checks: all raw parameter gradients before clipping
all optimizer tensors and step counters
saved activations/statistics when API promises them
timing: at least two independent process rounds for a promoted speed claim
kernel graph and whole host-dispatched latency separate
stage instrumentation separate from uninstrumented total
all conversions and required runtime work inside whole boundary
admission.candidate_selection: Report every attempted candidate and failure. A candidate selected on a tuning run needs fresh held-out timing before claiming a win; cannot select the minimum noisy sample.
admission.failure: Retain failed correctness/resource/build/timing rows with reasons. No timing admission for failed gates. No epsilon/tolerance/precision changes made merely to admit a candidate.
admission.claim_boundary: Coverage matrix is a map of tested and missing arithmetic, not a universal claim that all NN arithmetic has native OA implementations. CUDA API/library gains cannot establish native OA SASS scheduling superiority.
